# Installation

## 🛠️ From source

```bash
git clone https://github.com/druglogics/siflex.git
cd siflex
pip install -e .
```

## 📋 Requirements

Dependencies: `Python 3.7+`, `pandas`, `numpy`, `scipy`, `statsmodels`, `dash`, `dash-cytoscape`, `plotly`.

## 🔗 Source code

The source code is available at [github.com/druglogics/siflex](https://github.com/druglogics/siflex).
